items.title: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
items.summary: It won’t be long until Linux enthusiasts will be able to complete a clean kernel build in under 10 seconds thanks to advances in PC hardware and the AI-assisted optimization of compilers.
items.title_original: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
items.title_en: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
items.title_zh: Linux 爱好者看到 10 秒的内核编译时间即将到来
items.title_bilingual: Linux 爱好者看到 10 秒的内核编译时间即将到来 / Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
items.summary_zh: 得益于 PC 硬件的进步和编译器的 AI 辅助优化，不久之后 Linux 爱好者将能够在 10 秒内完成干净的内核构建。

items.title: Developer says AI decision model Jev beat Pokémon Red in under a week
items.summary: TypeSafe AI's Jev beat Pokémon Red in under a week, eventually reaching the Hall of Fame.
items.title_original: Developer says AI decision model Jev beat Pokémon Red in under a week
items.title_en: Developer says AI decision model Jev beat Pokémon Red in under a week
items.title_zh: 开发者称人工智能决策模型 Jev 在一周内击败了《神奇宝贝红》
items.title_bilingual: 开发者称人工智能决策模型 Jev 在一周内击败了《神奇宝贝红》 / Developer says AI decision model Jev beat Pokémon Red in under a week
items.summary_zh: TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 在不到一周的时间内击败了《精灵宝可梦 Red》，最终进入了名人堂。
